nina: Heads up I opened docs PR #623 - migration: sdk snippets + config examples for auth changes. Need reviewers and coordination with 2.3 cutoff. Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/preview/623

arthur: Noted. This references the new KMS key rotation behavior behind ff/kms-rotation. If landing under main nav, ops wants it after canary. Consider /2.3/security/kms-rotation as a versioned path.

nina: good call. I'll put it under /2.3/security/ and set `status: beta`.

terry: PM asks to include a one-line "what changed" at top for engineers migrating keys. Nina can you add that?

nina: added a brief summary and a migration checklist section. Also updated front matter: `version: "2.3"`, `status: "beta"`, `exclude_from_nav: true`.

arthur: I reviewed the snippets; small nit: sample config uses `rotation_period_days: 90` but we use 60 in the runtime defaults. Can you set example to 60?

nina: updated to 60. pushed.

docs-ci: hold-merge label applied to PR #623 (reason: release gating). Reminder scheduled for 2025-11-17 08:00 UTC.

maria: approved from release with the same constraint: don't merge before 2025-11-17 02:00 UTC unless urgent.

terry: approved from PM after the migration note addition.

arthur: approved code snippets.

nina: thanks all. I'll hold merge and coordinate with release channel before publishing. Closing thread for now.
